University of Malaya Asian Male Lower-Limb MSK Model - Assessment
================================================================

Dataset: A Three-Dimensional Lower Extremity Musculoskeletal Geometry Model of An Asian Male
DOI: 10.22452/RD/5T6TZ7
License: CC0 1.0 (verified 2026-09-22)
URL: https://researchdata.um.edu.my/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.22452/RD/5T6TZ7

Content:
- 67 STL files (58.3 MB zip)
- 42 muscles, 13 bones, 5 ligaments, 4 cartilages, 2 tendons, 1 meniscus
- MRI-derived, hip-to-foot lower extremity
- Published: 2026-04-22

Assessment Date: 2026-09-22 (Day 4cd)
Assessed By: Cloud Agent (right-foot-anatomy-atlas project)

RIGHT-FOOT RELEVANCE: REJECTED
==============================

CRITICAL EXCLUSION from readme.txt:
"In some regions, the boundaries between anatomical structures on the MRI images 
were challenging to distinguish. Such geometries were not included in the dataset, 
particularly minor tendon, minor ligaments and INTRINSIC FOOT MUSCLES which were 
hard to identify."

This explicitly states that INTRINSIC FOOT MUSCLES (including dorsal interossei, 
plantar intrinsics, lumbricals, etc.) are NOT INCLUDED in the dataset.

Target structures for right-foot-anatomy-atlas:
❌ Dorsal interossei (DI) - EXCLUDED (intrinsic foot muscles)
❌ Plantar layer muscles - EXCLUDED (intrinsic foot muscles)
❌ Per-ray digital vessels - No evidence in muscle-focused dataset
❓ Gastrocnemius/soleus - Likely present as leg muscles, but:
   - Already blocked: Andreassen VH bellies (Day 4az+4ba) failed Kabsch alignment
   - Need full file list to confirm presence
   - Even if present: single LE pack alignment = same Kabsch blocker as Andreassen

42-muscle list (from readme):
- "ranging from the most proximal psoas major to the most distal abductor digiti minimi"
- Despite mentioning "abductor digiti minimi", readme explicitly excludes intrinsic 
  foot muscles due to MRI identification difficulty
- Likely contains: hip muscles (psoas, gluteals), thigh muscles (quads, hamstrings), 
  leg muscles (gastroc, soleus, tibialis anterior/posterior, peroneals), possibly 
  extrinsic foot tendons (EDL, EHL, FDL, FHL)

INTEGRATION DECISION: REJECT
============================

Reasons:
1. Intrinsic foot muscles (DI, plantar layers) explicitly excluded per readme
2. Whole lower-extremity pack (hip→foot), not foot-specific anatomy
3. 42-muscle list lacks per-structure detail; no evidence of named foot soft tissue
4. Even if gastroc/soleus present: same LE Kabsch alignment blocker as Andreassen 
   (Day 4az+4ba failed; requires non-similarity registration)
5. 58.3 MB download not justified for 0 usable foot-specific named soft meshes

RECOMMENDATION: Monitor only; do not download; do not integrate.
